summary: The registrant, Digimarc Corp, filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Paul Carreiro as President and CEO effective July 6, 2026, and a related compensatory grant of LTIP Units in a subsidiary. The grant includes time-vesting and performance-vesting units tied to stock price thresholds. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, or SPAC event is described. The filing is a routine disclosure of executive compensation and employment arrangements. There are no deal terms or special-situation dynamics to monitor.
